create_vector_quantizer: create a VectorQuantizer module with a specified embedding dimension and number of embeddings for VQ-VAE quantization
create_vector_quantizer_ema: create a VectorQuantizerEMA module using exponential moving averages to update embedding vectors instead of an auxiliary loss
quantize_input_tensor: quantize an input tensor by finding the closest embedding vector for each element using Euclidean distance
compute_vqvae_loss: compute the VQ-VAE commitment loss and straight-through estimator gradient for training a vector quantized variational autoencoder
calculate_perplexity: calculate the perplexity of encodings to measure how many codebook vectors are actively used during quantization
